name: Paul
note: The apostle, a Pharisee from Tarsus, writing from Corinth.

name: The believers in Rome
note: A church of Jews and Gentiles that Paul had not founded.

name: Jesus
note: David's descendant, declared Son of God by the resurrection.

name: David
note: King of Israel and Jesus' ancestor; also quoted for forgiveness.

name: The moralizer
note: An imagined listener who judges others.

name: The Jewish teacher
note: An imagined Jewish interlocutor, confident in the law.

name: The Gentiles
note: Non-Jews.

name: The Jews
note: Entrusted with the oracles of God.

name: Abraham
note: The ancestor of Israel, justified by faith.

name: Sarah
note: Abraham's wife.

name: Adam
note: The first man, through whom sin entered the world.

name: Moses
note: The lawgiver; with him the law came in.

name: Israel
note: The people of the covenant, to whom the adoption and promises belong.

name: Isaac
note: Abraham's son of the promise.

name: Jacob
note: Isaac's younger son, also called Israel.

name: Esau
note: Isaac's elder son, also called Edom.

name: Pharaoh
note: The king of Egypt at the exodus.

name: Isaiah
note: The prophet, often quoted by Paul.

name: Elijah
note: The prophet who thought he was the only faithful one left.

name: The remnant
note: The faithful few of Israel.

name: The Gentile believers
note: Wild olive branches grafted in.

name: Those who persecute you
note: To be blessed and not cursed.

name: Your enemy
note: To be fed when hungry.
